prompts.text: An AVL tree is a Binary Search Tree where the difference in height between the left and right subtrees of any vertex is at most ______.
prompts.hint: It is the maximum allowable absolute difference in height.
prompts.explanation: By definition, the absolute difference between the heights of the left and right subtrees of any node in an AVL tree must be less than or equal to 1.

prompts.text: When deleting a node from a B-tree leaf, the leaf can become empty, which is a condition called ______.
prompts.hint: It is the opposite of overflow.
prompts.explanation: An underflow occurs in a B-tree when a node becomes empty after deletion and requires rebalancing.

prompts.hint: It moves an element upward to restore heap order.
prompts.explanation: heapifyUp is the process of propagating a newly inserted leaf node upward until the heap property is satisfied.

prompts.text: What is the name of the propagation process that pushes the root element down the heap to satisfy the min-heap condition after a removal?
prompts.hint: It moves an element downward to restore heap order.
prompts.explanation: heapifyDown is the process of propagating the new root element downward until the heap property is restored.
